extracted.intended_audience: Office of Security staff and agency managers preparing a reply to OMB Circular A-44 (agency administrative/financial officers)
extracted.subtask_short: agency reply to OMB Circular A-44
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing/submitting data and supporting memoranda for inclusion in an office reply to the implementation of OMB Circular A-44 (Revised), with attention to Management Effectiveness and Cost Reduction goals and supporting attachments (e.g., Training Branch memorandum).

rubrics_metrics.name: Management Effectiveness Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Section I, "Management Effectiveness Goals" — the staff has one item to report under Section I.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example: A change in scheduling and timing of the Security Education Program increased management effectiveness by releasing a Training Officer to participate in other briefings and training requirements. Include such items under Section I when they demonstrably improve management effectiveness even if they do not reduce costs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cost Reduction Goals
rubrics_metrics.description: Section II, "Cost Reduction Goals" — the staff submits a negative report on Section II.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a program change does not result in an overall cost reduction (e.g., scheduling change that does not lower total training costs), report that fact under Section II as a negative report. Explicitly state when efficiency gains did not translate into cost savings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Security Education Program scheduling and timing
rubrics_metrics.description: Itemized change in the scheduling and timing of the Security Education Program reported by the Chief, Training Branch, A&TS.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describe specific scheduling/timing changes and their operational effects (e.g., allowing one Training Officer to deliver the entire program where two were previously required). State both intended and realized impacts (management effectiveness, participation in other duties, and cost outcomes). Attach the originating memorandum from the Training Branch as supporting documentation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training staff utilization / staffing efficiency
rubrics_metrics.description: Measure whether program changes free staff (e.g., a Training Officer) to perform other duties and thereby increase management effectiveness.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Report how personnel reallocation affects overall office operations. Note that freeing a staff member for other tasks is a management effectiveness gain even if it does not reduce total program cost; quantify or describe the additional duties enabled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting and submission: include attachments and memorandum references
rubrics_metrics.description: Data for inclusion should be submitted as a memorandum with attachments (e.g., 'the attached memorandum from the Chief, Training Branch, A&TS itemizes...').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow requested memorandum structure (e.g., memorandum header: TO/FROM/SUBJECT; reference original request memos and DD/S numbers). Include clear attachments that itemize changes and their effects so they can be incorporated into the Office's reply to OMB Circular A-44.
